description:
## 1.0.4 (2026-11-25)

### Bug fixes

* Patching failed with "AliExpress coupon floor counters not found" on some 8.180.1 builds. Remove coupons popup, Block marketing pop-up layers, Disable promotions notifications, Remove affiliate tracking and Skip bundle deals now skip themselves with a warning when their code isn't in the APK, instead of stopping the whole patching run.
* 1.0.3 loaded 0 patches (it was missing its Android code); replaced by this version.
